text:
Type: rectangular ceramic window sill planter
Use: growing herbs or succulents on a window sill or shelf; living room, home office, kitchen window
Style: contemporary, rustic, coastal
Materials: glossy reactive glazed ceramic, textured matte base
Colors: light sea green, dark slate blue-grey
Shape: long narrow trough with flared sides, two-tone band, low and compact
Feel: fresh, earthy, calm
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, green plants; coastal or contemporary rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ceramic Indoor Window Sill Planter Box Pot - 3 x 12 x 3 Inch, Green and Blue
product.description: This crisp, cool green and grey planter will add a beautiful touch of color to your window sill. The bottom of the piece is hand-painted, while the main body is fired with a reactive glaze, making each of these charming pieces unique. 3.35"D x 12"W x 3.15"H Designed to hold plants; does not have drainage Ceramic stoneware Fired with reactive glaze and hand-painted. No two will be exactly alike.
